name: Choconsaurus
sum: Choconsaurus is a basal titanosauriform from the Albian Huincul Formation of Neuquen, Argentina, known from the most complete basal titanosaur skeleton of 2017.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MMCh-PV 44/10, found at Villa El Chocon before 1996.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Simón et al. 2018
